maker: Kenrobotech Co., Ltd. (建ロボテック株式会社)
name: Kenrobotech Rebar-tying Tomorobo RTM1-X1-A1
summary: Small collaborative robot that travels along the rebar mesh of slabs and ground slabs and ties the crossings with two commercial MAX handheld rebar tiers, while workers do the skilled work. Made by Kenrobotech in Kagawa, Japan, and used by Japanese contractors and rebar firms.

germany.statusNote: Sold only in Japan: open price on request, with lease, rental, test use on site and a dealer scheme for rental and leasing firms, all through the Japanese maker. No German or EU distributor or CE information found.

specs.label: Bar diameters
specs.conditions: may not tie where three φ16 bars cross; heavy-bar version RTM1-X1-A2 covers φ16–φ32

specs.label: Bar spacing
specs.quote: 配筋ピッチは100～300ｍｍ内で25ｍｍごとに対応。

specs.label: Tying cycle
specs.conditions: per crossing, 200 mm spacing, two tying tools
specs.quote: 2.7ｓ（200ｍｍピッチ、結束機2台使用時1カ所当り）

specs.label: Runtime per charge
specs.conditions: 200 mm spacing, two tying tools, full battery, 25 °C; charging takes 6 h
specs.quote: 12時間（200ｍｍピッチ、結束機2台使用、バッテリーフル充電時 環境温度25度の場合）

specs.label: Dimensions L × W × H
specs.conditions: width adjustable; detachable sensor not included

specs.label: Tying patterns
specs.value: every crossing, staggered, every third crossing
specs.quote: 全結束、チドリ結束、2つ飛び結束

specs.label: Operating conditions
specs.value: 0–40 °C, 0–80 % humidity, not in rain or snow
specs.quote: 温度／0℃～40℃、湿度／0％～80％　※雨天、降雪時は使用できません。

specs.label: Tying tool
specs.conditions: sold with or without the tools; tie wire refill about every 40 min
specs.quote: 鉄筋結束トモロボ(RTM1-X1-A1)はRB440Tに対応しており

notes: Travels on its own along the rebar mesh (one way or back and forth); the maker speaks of a vehicle body but does not describe the running gear, so wheels is an assumption from 'travel' wording.
Senses bar crossings with width and rebar sensors and adapts to spacing changes, height offsets and tilt.
Three safety sensors: low body sensor, high sensor for people, bar-end sensor.
The base unit is sold without the MAX tying tools unless the set with two tools is bought, so handsIncluded is false.
Registered in Japan's NETIS technology database (SK-200003-A); a slider set for automatic sideways moves has been available since February 2022.
